newsitem.title: JAPAN: Bandai aims for 97/98 Tamagotchi sales of Y17 bln.
newsitem.headline: Bandai aims for 97/98 Tamagotchi sales of Y17 bln.

text.p: Bandai Co Ltd said on Wednesday that it aims to achieve 17 billion yen worth of sales from its "Tamagotchi" virtual pet toy this business year to March 31, 1998.
It said sales of Tamagotchi totalled 3.5 billion yen in fiscal 1996/97.

"For the current business year, we aim to sell 20 million units of Tamagotchi in Japan and plan to officially launch the product in overseas markets in July," a Bandai official told a news conference.
Bandai also said it expects a parent operating profit of eight billion yen in 1997/98, up from 6.8 billion yen in 1996/97.

It said it posted a 6.5 billion yen loss from its Pippin Atmark machines, a video game player with Internet capabilities, in 1996/97. But a Bandai official said the company has no plan to change its business plan for the product for now.
The toymaker said on Tuesday that it had called off a merger with Sega Enterprises Ltd, which was due to take effect on October 1.
